paragraphs.text: Gorev Hadszak is a retired Wojek on the plane of Ravnica . Grizzled in every sense of the word—his face, and of unknown age, but despite his gray hair and weathered features, he still looks like he could wrestle a drunken ogre out of a bar or knock out a Rakdos spiker. His wrists were as thick as most men's calves and his arms were covered in scars.

On the anniversary day of the dissolution of the Guildpact , Gorev took his nephew Pel Javya to see a theatre play about the historic event that marked the day. On the Thespian's Stage , scenes were acted out according to the stories - with the Dimir vampire lord Szadek facing off against the detective Agrus Kos .

Pel asked his uncle what life had been like under the Guildpact, and Gorev mused about how it had been serving at Sunhome under the parun Razia . He told his nephew that his vigilance and passion must outweigh their desire to destroy and control. That's why the play on the stage play was a tragedy — it was not a triumph of Kos and the Boros over Szadek and Augustin. It was about the destruction of the greatest creation ever put on paper. The greatest spell ever cast - the Guildpact itself.

Pel Javya knew that the real fight for Ravnica lay strewn throughout the Undercity, where the Dimir lay out of sight, pulling their invisible puppet strings to organize their next attack. The Absolution of the Guildpact may have just been a play, but for Pel, it contained a message that would shape a life's work.
